sentences.en: In the course of the past year, prices have doubled.
sentences.zh: 在过去一年里，价格翻了一番。

sentences.en: Houses here are double the price of those in Kobe.
sentences.zh: 这里的房子是神户那些的两倍贵。

sentences.en: His salary is double what it was seven years ago.
sentences.zh: 他现在的薪水比七年前翻了一番。

senses.zh: 两倍的，双重的；双人的，双份的
